title: Proper-counit and open-tensor system compact-support projection word
statement: Let $S,X,Y$ be schemes, $f:X\to Y$, $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$ a compactification, $a_Y:Y\to S$, and $B$ a strict commutative coefficient tower. Use the actual ordinary system geometric adjunctions, derived inverse images, exact open extension $J$ and derived proper image $R$ [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data], the closed tensor calculi [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus], and their normalized tensor pullbacks [def-coef-etale-system-image-tensor]. Define compact-support projection data to consist of those geometric presentations and an open tensor isomorphism $J(j^*H\otimes^LM)\cong H\otimes^LJM$ whose adjunction transpose is the tensor of the identity with the open unit, followed by inverse tensor pullback. Put $F=RJ$ and $a_X^*=j^*p^*a_Y^*$. Define the proper projection $H\otimes^LRN\to R(p^*H\otimes^LN)$ to be the transpose of tensor pullback followed by the proper counit. Define the compact-support projection word to be this proper map at $H=a_Y^*P,N=JM$, followed by $R$ of the inverse open tensor isomorphism. Name its source and target bifunctors. Define evaluation data to consist of exact evaluations at $S,X,Y,Z$, the normalized tensor bridges at $X,Y$ [def-coef-etale-system-derived-tensor-evaluation], and the recorded unit/counit-normalized evaluations of the base inverse/direct image, proper image and open image. All these data describe operations on the whole sequence site and impose no boundedness or cartesianness condition on inputs.
